title: Seated Tasting Experience at Konzelmann Winery
requirements: Infants and small children can ride in a pram or stroller
All areas and surfaces are wheelchair accessible
Suitable for all physical fitness levels
cancellation: For a full refund, cancel at least 24 hours before the scheduled departure time.
blurb: Enjoy our refreshed seated tasting experience in our brand new tasting hall, designed for a relaxed and personalized way to explore our wines. When you book, you’ll secure your seat and can choose your experience upon arrival - select a pre-curated tasting flight, build your own flight of four wines, or unwind with a glass of wine paired with our curated snack board, all while a dedicated wine consultant shares the history of the winery and guides you through each tasting.
